heading: Senior Citizens’ Savings Scheme (SCSS) – A Secure Investment for Retirees
intro: The Senior Citizens’ Savings Scheme (SCSS)</span > is a government-backed investment option that provides higher returns than fixed deposits, guaranteed quarterly payouts, and significant tax benefits. It is one of the safest and most rewarding investment plans designed for retirees seeking financial security.
featuresIntro: SCSS is an ideal investment option for senior citizens looking for stable, risk-free income. Below is a breakdown of its key features:
dsaBenefits: Age Requirement: Individuals aged 60 years or above.
Early Retirement: Individuals aged 55-60 who have retired under Superannuation, VRS, or Special VRS.
Defense Personnel: Retired Defense Services personnel (excluding civilian defense employees) can open an account from age 50.
Account Holding: Accounts can be opened individually or jointly with a spouse.
